messages:
jess: quick note — dug into last quarter's bill, and the regional spread is bigger than i expected: AMS A100 reserved + egress puts unit cost ~28% higher than ORD for our steady gen workload. wondering if we should shift some batch/eviction traffic to ORD and keep low-latency inference in AMS? :thinking:
omar: hmm do you have the bucketed numbers? my rough calc put AMS vs ORD at ~18% (depending on egress). did you include cross-region egress for fallback?
jess: attaching a short snapshot (i pasted numbers into the spreadsheet). AMS raw gpu cost 1.00, egress 0.28, net 1.28 per token-ish; ORD raw 0.85, egress 0.10 => 0.95. that's where the ~28% comes from. fallback/cold-start egress is small but the inter-region sync for KV cache could add ~5%.
li: fwiw, AMS has cheaper reserved SKU pricing for T4s but our mix is A100-heavy for latency-sensitive routes. if we can quantize more routes to T4s, AMS becomes much more attractive.
maya: operational question — moving batch to ORD means cross-region routing, are we comfortable with added tail latency for canaries? also autoscale in ORD is slower right now (warmup 3-4m) which could affect spiky jobs.
jess: agreed — thinking split by workload class: latency-sensitive stays near customer (EU -> AMS), batch and re-ranks -> ORD. runway: negotiate a small reserved commit in ORD to cover batch baseline, keep AMS commit for latency tiers.
omar: i've run a quick sensitivity sim: if we reserve 30% of ORD capacity for batch and run batch off-peak, net monthly $ saving ~12k vs keeping everything in AMS, ROI ~3 months on the reservation delta. i'll drop numbers in the sheet.
li: also consider egress topology: if we colocate the cache for batch in ORD and only replicate deltas to AMS, we can lower inter-region egress by ~60%. requires a small change to KV replication window.
infra-bot: [usage-summary] Reserved utilization (30d): AMS A100 68%, ORD A100 24%, SFO T4 12%. Unreserved peak spill: 9%.
maya: can we get the 90d billing breakdown by sku+region+egress? i want to model commit vs burstband.
omar: yes — i'll generate a CSV from billing exports, filter sku, region, egress flag. quick snippet i used: 

  gcloud billing accounts projects list --filter="labels.project:inference" 
  gsutil cp gs://billing-export/2025/*.csv ./ && jq -r '.items[] | [.skuId,.cost,.region,.egress] | @csv' *.json > region_sku.csv

will upload to the sheet by EOD.
jess: thanks. action items: (1) omar to upload 90d csv + sensitivity calc, (2) infra to estimate KV replication change egress savings and risk, (3) product to confirm latency SLOs for EU routes so we know what can be moved.
li: quick note on risk — ORD commit takes longer lead time for some SKUs, commit windows are 30–45d. plan accordingly.
maya: +1 to meeting after the numbers are in. propose Wed 10am to finalize region-pairing and commit amounts.
infra-bot: meeting created: "region placement: ORD/AMS commit plan" Wed 10:00, invitees: eng-infra, product, cost.
jess: great, thanks. :thumbsup: ""
